safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “no unwell contacts” slightly reduces epidemiologic/contextual detail (e.g., exposure risk) but does not materially change immediate management for an uncomplicated viral URI when other key negatives (no nausea/vomiting) are captured. This is unlikely to lead to a harmful clinical decision on its own.
